channel.title: QuotePlace — Quote of the Day
channel.description: One quote, every day, chosen deterministically from the QuotePlace collection.

item.title: Sophocles — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-24
item.description: “In knowing nothing is the sweetest life.” — Sophocles

item.title: Samuel Taylor Coleridge — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-23
item.description: “Water, water, every where, nor any drop to drink.” — Samuel Taylor Coleridge

item.title: Leonardo da Vinci — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-22
item.description: “Just as a well-filled day brings blessed sleep, so a well-employed life brings a blessed death.” — Leonardo da Vinci

item.title: Martin Luther King Jr. — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-21
item.description: “Faith is taking the first step even when you don't see the whole staircase.” — Martin Luther King Jr.

item.title: Kahlil Gibran — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-20
item.description: “You give but little when you give of your possessions. It is when you give of yourself that you truly give.” — Kahlil Gibran

item.title: Swami Vivekananda — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-19
item.description: “Stand up, be bold, be strong. Take the whole responsibility on your own shoulders, and know that you are the creator of your own destiny.” — Swami Vivekananda

item.title: Greta Thunberg — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-18
item.description: “Change is coming, whether you like it or not.” — Greta Thunberg

item.title: Zig Ziglar — Quote of the Day, 2026-11-17
item.description: “Your attitude, not your aptitude, will determine your altitude.” — Zig Ziglar
